§6Sodium-22 Source (Positrons)§f

§aAn ion source that turns fluid into positrons. Yes, antimatter from a canister.§f

This ion source consumes Sodium-22 fluid and emits positron particles. Positrons are the antimatter counterpart of electrons and are used in downstream antimatter recipes.

Place it at the end of a LINAC just like any other ion source. The particle species it emits depends on the fluid you feed it, so check JEI to confirm what Sodium-22 produces.

The Laser Ion Source variant is an upgrade tier, but that comes later. For now, this basic version gets your positron beam started.

§ePS:§f Positrons are useful for making Positronium, a muon-electron bound state. That is a whole different rabbit hole.
